DA_02.script:
MEMBERSET [d/Monat] = "202601" TO "202612"
MEMBERSET [d/Measures] = "Amount_EUR"
DATA([d/Account] = "ERL_PROD", [d/CostCenter] = "#") = LINK([NW_SALES_DRIVERS_V2], [d/Measures] = "Units", [d/Version] = "public.Budget2026", [d/Entity] = [d/Entity], [d/ProductGroup] = [d/ProductGroup]) * LINK([NW_SALES_DRIVERS_V2], [d/Measures] = "Price_EUR", [d/Version] = "public.Budget2026", [d/Entity] = [d/Entity], [d/ProductGroup] = [d/ProductGroup])
DATA([d/Account] = "VAR_MAT", [d/CostCenter] = "#") = LINK([NW_SALES_DRIVERS_V2], [d/Measures] = "Units", [d/Version] = "public.Budget2026", [d/Entity] = [d/Entity], [d/ProductGroup] = [d/ProductGroup]) * LINK([NW_SALES_DRIVERS_V2], [d/Measures] = "StdCost_EUR", [d/Version] = "public.Budget2026", [d/Entity] = [d/Entity], [d/ProductGroup] = [d/ProductGroup])
